claims.statement: EU rules require prior notification and consent for disposal waste and hazardous or most mixed waste sent for recovery within the EU.
Most new Waste Shipment Regulation provisions apply from May 2026, including electronic procedures through a central EU system.

economics.acquisition_route: Start with one repetitive waste stream and two facilities on a single Poland-EU corridor
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 500000 tonnes across several EU corridors at 25 PLN net revenue could reach 12.5m PLN annual revenue and over 5m PLN founder equity in years 6-8
economics.founder_time: 3-5 hours/day; licensed transport and legal advice remain with partners
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 15-40 PLN per tonne plus 3000-8000 PLN notification-workflow fee
economics.retention_or_repeat: Monthly waste generation and recurring consent or general-information workflows

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Corridor-specific consent times, rejection reasons, prices and fulfilled capacity become proprietary routing data
fingerprint.customer: Industrial waste producers, brokers and recovery facilities on selected Poland-EU corridors
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Environmental consultants, BDO advisers and recovery-facility partnerships
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: One-waste-code corridor exchange with facility scope checks, capacity reservations and electronic document orchestration
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Waste holder pays per reserved tonne and a workflow fee when authorities consent
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A waste stream lacks confirmed recovery capacity and the shipment needs a compliant route

founder_fit: Data routing and document automation fit
Poland is a practical corridor origin
Asset-light exchange avoids owning trucks or plants

structure.control_point: verified facility slots plus corridor-specific consent workflow
structure.critical_dependency: Facilities and competent authorities must accept the transaction structure for the chosen waste code

thesis: Match Polish waste holders with EU recovery facilities offering documented monthly capacity, while a workflow assembles notification, consent and movement evidence without acting as the authority.
title: Cross-Border Waste Recovery Slot Exchange
uncertainties: Demand, margins and legal role boundaries are unvalidated
The best initial waste code and corridor are unknown
